evidence.boundary-evaluation: docs/research/guest-labeling.md evaluates two independently verified clean-state runs. The previous SELinux failure is resolved under the scoped guest assumption. Java activity initialization and splash rendering are established; stable useful UI, instrument initialization and a hardware dependency are not established. AndroidX diagnostic messages are followed by lifecycle and rendering and are not promoted to fatal errors. This is consistent with the existing architecture; no material architecture change requires reconciliation.
evidence.continuation-decision: .agents/plans/guest-startup.yaml drafts one executable startup tracing task and an explicit decision task. The clear bounded continuation is exact-stock static inspection and observational native/framework tracing of the surviving splash. No behavior substitution or hardware modeling is authorized by that task. The standing authorization permits admission after plan inspection and a tasking commit before execution. All work remains local; no external publication or physical device access occurred.
